gate_decisions.reason: The locked-P000 physical-refinement transfer question is terminally answered by a current-language no-go, a four-clause minimum extension interface, and an exact conditional support-pullback criterion. Selecting new physical semantics would be a new objective, not another stage of this transfer task.
The reviewed conclusion is an interface/no-go classification; formalization is deferred until an independently justified native refinement structure exists.
The result does not claim novelty for pullback or finite-cover facts and preserves the prior-art/type-map separations already reviewed in the parent program.
All finite witness claims and the representability examples are deterministic and independently bound by the task-local checker.
Locality, physical refinement, support transport and cross-refinement mixed direction are integrated into one dependency/no-go interface; no general-purpose tool is introduced.
The review checks equivalence, observation, abstract-cover and physical-refinement separations, verifies manifest blobs, and preserves the P000-L1 no-duplicate boundary.
